content.title: 1 Bank Stock to Keep an Eye On and 2 We Brush Off
content.summary: Banks play a critical role in the financial system, providing everything from commercial loans to wealth management and payment processing services. But concerns about loan losses and tightening regulations have tempered enthusiasm, limiting the banking industry’s gains to 2.9% over the past six months. This return lagged the S&P 500’s 9.9% climb.
